title.narrative: Improve the inclusive and sustainable development of agricultural value chains
Migliorare lo sviluppo inclusivo e sostenibile delle filiere agricole

description.narrative: Il Progetto riproduce ed amplia l'intervento progettuale UNIDO N°170217 (AID 11671) e mira a supportare il Governo del Mozambico nei suoi sforzi verso una trasformazione strutturale dello sviluppo del settore agroindustriale. L’iniziativa supporta i programmi del Ministero dell’Industria e Commercio a favore del potenziamento e dell'integrazione di una struttura in grado di promuovere la produzione agricola e sostenere il settore agroindustriale nelle aree interessate. La strategia di implementazione prevedrà il coinvolgimento di attori locali, pubblici e privati, che metteranno a disposizione le loro strutture e conoscenze per il successo dell’iniziativa, come nel caso delle istituzioni di istruzione e formazione tecnica e professionale (TVETs). Il progetto, oltre ad ispirarsi alla strategia di promozione e sviluppo del settore orticolo lungo la Beira Corredor promossa da AICS nella Regione Centrale del Mozambico, lavorerà in stretta collaborazione con ENI, FAO e altri attori che realizzano iniziative finanziate dall'Agenzia Italiana per lo Sviluppo Cooperazione (AICS) nelle aree target. L’intervento sarà attuato nelle Province di Manica e Cabo Delgado con possibili interventi in altre aree lungo il Beira Corredor (Sofala e Tete) secondo i risultati e le indicazioni prodotte dalla valutazione iniziale dei fabbisogni. Il progetto ha una particolare attenzione nel coinvolgere giovani e donne.

The Project is the scale-up of the UNIDO project intervention N ° 170217 (AID 11671) and aims to support the Government of Mozambique in its efforts towards a structural transformation of the development of the agro-industrial sector. The initiative supports the programs of the Ministry of Industry and Commerce in favor of the strengthening and integration of a structure capable of promoting agricultural production and supporting the agro-industrial sector in the targeted areas. The implementation strategy will encompass the involvement of local, public and private actors, who will make their structures and knowledge available for the success of the initiative, as in the case of technical and vocational education and training institutions (TVETs). Besides being inspired by the strategy of promotion and development of the horticultural sector along Beira Corredor promoted by AICS in the Central Region of Mozambique, the project will work in close cooperation with ENI, FAO and other actors implementing initiatives funded by the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS) in the target areas. The project will be implemented in the Provinces of Manica and Cabo Delgado with possible interventions in other areas along the Beira Corredor (Sofala and Tete) in accordance with the findings and indications produced by the initial needs assessment.The project particularly focuses on youth and women.

tag.narrative: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation

By 2030, double the agricultural productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers, in particular women, indigenous peoples, family farmers, pastoralists and fishers, including through secure and equal access to land, other productive resources and inputs, knowledge, financial services, markets and opportunities for value addition and non-farm employment
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture

Increase investment, including through enhanced international cooperation, in rural infrastructure, agricultural research and extension services, technology development and plant and livestock gene banks in order to enhance agricultural productive capacity in developing countries, in particular least developed countries

Increase the access of small-scale industrial and other enterprises, in particular in developing countries, to financial services, including affordable credit, and their integration into value chains and markets
